description: Sparse trajectory reconstruction (noise-free linear inverse problem) with the existing pretrained unicycle diffusion model. Protocol fixed before any validation/test run.

data.collect_settings_from: /u/rzhang26/CleanDiffuser_rebuttal_pnp/run_collect_unicycle_full64.sbatch (require_full_horizon, horizon 64, dt 0.1, x/y lim [-8,8], v [0,2], w [-1.5,1.5])

observations.mask_rule: rng = np.random.default_rng(mask_seed); for j in range(n): S_j = sorted(rng.choice(np.arange(1, 64), 16, replace=False))

xT_seeds.rule: x_T for trajectory j: torch.manual_seed(base + j); torch.randn((1,64,6), device='cuda:0'); shared by all methods

objective: f(x) = 0.5 * ||A x - y||^2 in normalized coordinates, y = A x*_norm, grad f = A^T(Ax - y), L = 1; reward R = -f

pnp_pgd.init: unguided DDIM-20 sample of the same x_T (20 NFE counted)
pnp_pgd.extension_note: eta upper extension 1.5 (not 2.0) to stay strictly inside the gradient-step stability range eta < 2/L; K is a compute budget and is not extended (reported if K=20 is selected)

pnp_pgd_ddim10_K10.init: unguided DDIM-10 sample (agent with diffusion_steps 20, sampling_steps 10) of the same x_T (10 NFE counted)

selection.criterion: minimize validation mean (over the 20 validation trajectories) of per-trajectory unobserved-xy MSE in physical units (mean over the 47 unobserved timesteps t in {1..63} \ S and the x,y dims)
selection.tie_break: lower NFE, then lower gradient count, then grid order
selection.boundary_rule: if a selected eta / w_cg / noise index lies on the boundary of its grid, add the pre-registered extension point in that direction ONCE (crossed with the full grid of the other hyper-parameters), re-select over the extended grid, never extend again

metrics.unobs_xy_mse: physical m^2, mean over unobserved timesteps (t in 1..63 not in S) and dims x,y (PRIMARY)
metrics.unobs_obs4_mse: physical, mean over unobserved timesteps and all 4 obs dims (x, y, cos th, sin th)
metrics.action_mse: mean over t=0..63 and (v, w) of (clip(a_hat) - a*)^2
metrics.obs_xy_rmse: physical m, sqrt of mean over the 16 observed timesteps x 2 dims
metrics.e_dyn: unicycle_eval._feasibility_gaps(planned_obs, _open_loop_rollout_obs(env(terminate_on_oob=False), true o_0, clip(planned actions), 64))['mean_l2_future'] (mean over t=1..63 of physical 4-dim L2)

figures.representative_rule: test trajectories at the 25th/50th/75th percentile (nearest rank on the sorted list, index round(q*(n-1))) of the UNGUIDED unobserved-xy MSE; supplementary figure: fixed test indices 0..3

timing.batching: batch size 1 per trajectory (all 100 test trajectories, each timed individually with torch.cuda.synchronize before/after; model loading and the CPU e_dyn rollout excluded); 3 warm-up calls per method before timing; secondary: batched throughput (all 100 in one batch) / 100
